steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: You know...

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: I rather like Bresk this time of year.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: The sun no longer rises and falls, there is no distinction between day and night... and there is no need to pretend that anything is under the light anymore.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: The Marshal calls it 'The Autumn of Troubles'.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: Time is of the essence, Your Imperial Highness. The situation grows more tense as we speak, as I enjoy your hospitality and your tea.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: The Marshal awaits your reply.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: I see even Marshal Evgeny is flustered. It seems there is truly great trouble in Ursus.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: You are correct.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: The mellow response from Deity Grypherburg is unacceptable—The Marshal is not the only one who thinks so.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: I expect he has realized how wisely his father acted in that insurrection. The Fourth Army could have had a worse outcome than being sent to the border.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: So, has young Evgeny made up his mind to be at the forefront?

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: The Marshal is simply performing the duty of a soldier of Ursus, to protect her by standing where the danger is the greatest.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: Our only problem lies with you, Your Imperial Highness.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: The Marshal needs to know that you are willing to continue to cooperate.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: Is this his notice to me?

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: A request made of a friend.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: The Marshal values your friendship and trusts your wisdom. He believes that, even at a time like this, the interests of Bresk and the Fourth Army are closely aligned.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: Besides, he is not asking you to do anything other than give the nod.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: He seems to think it is an easy thing.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: Does he think the Tsar a fool? Does he think Chairman Witte an idiot?

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: There is no middle ground... just as the sun cannot coexist with the night.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: The Marshal understands your situation. He is happy to share in your burden.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: In any case, there is considerable room for interpretation for the fall of an Emperor's Blade. The Marshal is glad to make the interpretation for you.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: 'The Fourth Army assisted Bresk in suppressing a rebellion in the Far North.' As long as you are willing to cooperate, that will be the only sentence in the Fourth Army's report to Grypherburg.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: You do not even need to nod. The Marshal will accept silence.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: No, that's not it... if the Marshal truly understands me, he should know that it was never Deity Grypherburg's inquiry I was concerned about...

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: The people who live upon my land, the people of Ursus... they are my only concern.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: The Marshal understands your benevolence and vows that no one shall cross the line you have drawn.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: Young, impatient Evgeny... I would not wish to see my dear friend put himself in danger.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: Even if I do keep silent as he wishes, it would simply be one fewer pebble in his path. How does he intend to handle the mighty boulders?

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: That is not something you need concern yourself with. Be it boulders or anything else, the Marshal is confident he will overcome all foes that stand in the way of Ursine glory.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: Do I take it that I have your response?

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: Field Marshal Evgeny sends his regards.

steps.name: Solemn Ursine Officer
steps.text: For the glory of Ursus.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: For the glory of Ursus...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Are you alright, Ksenia? I can carry both of you, if necessary!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: N-No, I'm fine...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I just don't understand... why do we have to be in such a hurry?

options: I have a theory...
If the government has already learned about the ore vein incident...
There is only one explanation for the widespread silence in the Far North—
Ursus will not allow news of the vein exhaustion to get out.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Look at the sky, Doctor!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Was it like this when we came in?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: No... Am I seeing things?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Why that color... again?
Conspicuously red, the color of warning. You do not even need to look up to see it.
It begins to cover the gray skies, and everything below them.

options: ...The army.
The warning light of the Ursine armies.
They're here.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Why...?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Why would the army come to the Far North at a time like this? They shouldn't be here!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Doctor. High-energy Originium reaction on a large scale, five kilometers to the northwest. Someone is approaching, fast.

options: We need to get back to the lab, now.
We need to let Amiya know at once.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Are you alright, Ksenia? We're speeding up!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Yes, the lab...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: We need to get back to the lab.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: This way!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: The emergency communications equipment is on the top-floor observation deck. The key is in the director's office—

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Follow me!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Whisper) Those footsteps didn't come from any of us.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Whisper) Is there someone else here?

options: There aren't many of them.
We don't have time.
We need to reach Amiya ASAP.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Sorry, there's no emergency lighting here. I've lit a candle.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Yes, here's the communications equipment... I've never used it. Not sure how long its range is.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It's an Ursine military communicator.

options: You've seen one before?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Raidian has something similar. She helped the Ursine army's research into such equipment years ago. Looks like they've put it into production already.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: If it's what I think it is, then it's a form of high-performance, large-area broadcasting equipment.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It's equipped with a high-powered Arts unit, roughly the equivalent of a hundred standard military communicators.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It was designed to broadcast urgent messages to military facilities in a large area. Experts at perceptive Arts, such as Raidian, are also able to receive such messages.

options: Isn't that a good thing?
Why do you look so anxious?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: We can't specify the frequency to use.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: If we use this device to send a message, the nearby Ursine army will receive it too, immediately revealing our position.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Doctor...

options: ...Send the message.
Send the message, then move at once.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Tell me what message you want to send, and I'll operate it.

options: The Ursine ore veins are near exhausted.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Recorded. What's next?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Look out!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Whoa—!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Wh-Why are they attacking the lab?

options: At least one army is intervening in the Far North.
They're trying to enforce a blackout—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Message recorded!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Sending—

options: Let's get out of here! Now!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Doctor, Ksenia, grab on to me tightly.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: We will—
Hello... hello—!
Damn. Did we make it in time?
You were pretty tough when you came for me, monster. Don't die here!
Do you hear me? Do you hear—
...Doctor?
